case_families.name: Malformed, oversized and sensitive raw input
synthetic_inputs: 524289 ASCII spaces: one byte above the 512 KiB input bound
{"a":1,"\u0061":2}: duplicate decoded key
50 opening brackets, the number 0, then 50 closing brackets
{"secret":"do-not-echo"}
{"schema_version":"2.0.0"}
The single byte 0xff
case_families.asserted_result: Every preview throws. For each caught error, String(describing:) must omit the literal do-not-echo sentinel. This method does not assert a particular error case or measure memory/time.
case_families.recovery_evidence: No per-input successful retry is asserted in this method. The valid fixture, export and fork controls in AT-03/05/09 pass in the same recorded suite.
case_families.limits: A raw Data boundary test, not a real Files provider or a general sensitive-diagnostic audit.

case_families.name: Aggregate node limit
synthetic_inputs: An array containing 16384 zero values; the containing array is an additional parser node
case_families.asserted_result: Preview throws the exact TransferError.tooComplex case.
case_families.recovery_evidence: The method proceeds to structural URI controls and a valid local canonical snapshot; no accepted near-node-limit preview is asserted.
case_families.limits: This establishes the declared node rejection, not a device memory or latency budget.

case_families.name: Frozen shape, kinds, types and missing inputs
synthetic_inputs: The unchanged 129-record conformance.json corpus
All 29 schema-derived selection kinds: valid minimal settings, then an unrecognized settings property and numeric enabled=1
Canonical build mutations: unexpected=true, revision=true, lifecycle=approved, created_at=2026-02-30T00:00:00Z, an ID ending in newline, absent locks, and numeric monthly_budget_amount=100
case_families.asserted_result: Every corpus outcome matches its declared valid flag; each kind first validates, then both invalid mutations throw. All seven malformed complete-build variants throw.
case_families.recovery_evidence: Positive corpus members and the valid per-kind value are checked in the same tests. Invalid complete-build mutations use independent copies of the original fixture.
case_families.limits: The schema evaluator is bounded to the bundled frozen keywords and the documented client representation subset. These are not compatibility or public-source approvals.

case_families.name: Exact numeric encoding and unsupported numbers
synthetic_inputs: Rejected tokens: 1e-999, 1e999, 1.234567890123456, 0.0000000000001, and 0. followed by 60 zeros then 1e-64
The public fixture with revision 1000000000000000 represented as 1e15 on the wire
case_families.asserted_result: All eight supported tokens re-encode and parse to equal JSONValue values; all five unsupported tokens throw. The exponent revision remains exact through snapshot, export, preview and a repeated export/preview.
case_families.recovery_evidence: Successful repeated encode/decode is explicit. No rounding of unsupported inputs or fabricated replacement value is accepted.
case_families.limits: The existing numeric subset is not arbitrary JSON-number interoperability; money fields remain schema-constrained decimal strings.

case_families.name: Private export projection and secret references
synthetic_inputs: The public canonical fixture plus extensions.x_private=PRIVATE
The projected build with name=secret://private/ref
case_families.asserted_result: The private local snapshot cannot be preview-imported. Export omits PRIVATE and supplies the explicit public.alias owner. The secret-reference name is rejected by both export and preview.
case_families.recovery_evidence: The projected output successfully reopens through preview before the separate secret-reference mutation is attempted.
case_families.limits: This does not prove arbitrary free-text secret detection, every field spelling, user disclosure review, destination-provider behavior or remote-copy revocation.

case_families.name: Private local serialization stays separate from import
synthetic_inputs: Canonical local build with selection notes=Private local workload notes and extensions.x_private=Private local metadata
case_families.asserted_result: Local encoding and reopening preserve the complete immutable value and locks, including private fields. Sending the same bytes to preview throws exact TransferError.sensitiveContent.
case_families.recovery_evidence: The successful local round trip is explicit and is not replaced by a sanitizing persistence projection.
case_families.limits: Local encoded bytes remain private. This is not authorization to send them to Files or a service.

case_families.name: Canonical private infrastructure cannot be exported
synthetic_inputs: The unchanged canonical build, including its index_name setting
case_families.asserted_result: The complete local snapshot validates, but export with public.alias throws exact TransferError.sensitiveContent.
case_families.recovery_evidence: AT-05/09 use the test helper publicSource(), which explicitly removes index_name to construct a separate synthetic transferable fixture; they do not silently sanitize this rejected input.
case_families.limits: Only the named canonical private field is dynamically exercised here. The source guard has additional known-field and normalized credential-name checks; complete spelling-family tests are not inferred.

case_families.name: Output expansion cannot create an unreadable local snapshot
synthetic_inputs: Canonical build plus extensions.x_padding containing 270000 slash characters, initially encoded with sortedKeys and withoutEscapingSlashes
case_families.asserted_result: Compact input is below the byte bound and validates. Ordinary JSONEncoder output is above the bound. BuildSnapshot.encoded() throws exact TransferError.oversized instead of returning those bytes.
case_families.recovery_evidence: The untouched original compact input decodes again to the same immutable snapshot after rejection.
case_families.limits: This is a local serialization guard. No persistence write, actual disk failure or Files destination is exercised by this method.

case_families.name: Untrusted import identity becomes a distinct local fork
synthetic_inputs: A valid public bare fixture
A format-version-1 fixture envelope with a syntactically valid, untrusted a repeated 40 times sourceSha
The same envelope with formatVersion=2
An empty localOwner supplied to fork
case_families.asserted_result: The fork has a different build ID, supplied local.test owner, revision 1 and draft lifecycle, preserving every lock and selection and leaving the original snapshot equal. The fixture envelope reports synthetic=true; version 2 and empty localOwner throw.
case_families.recovery_evidence: A valid preview and valid local fork are both directly exercised. No successful retry after the invalid envelope or invalid owner is asserted within that method.
case_families.limits: A parser-accepted sourceSha/dataMode is untrusted metadata, not authentication. A new value does not prove UI confirmation, collision-free database insertion or cross-user server authorization.

case_families.name: Rejected transitions preserve an acknowledged draft
synthetic_inputs: An incomplete draft with an empty selection list
A complete canonical build changed to zero selections
An acknowledged SQLite draft with selections=[] and locks.catalog_snapshot_id=catalog.pinned
{"schema_version":"2.0.0","secret":"private"} passed to preview while that draft exists
case_families.asserted_result: Invalid draft-to-snapshot transitions throw without changing input Data. Separate DraftStore instances reopen the saved row with equal payload, revision 1, one history record and analysisIsCurrent=false. The malicious preview throws and the row remains equal afterward.
case_families.recovery_evidence: Actual SQLite reopen and reread after each rejected transition are explicit. The test does not add a new valid imported fork to the store.
case_families.limits: This result belongs to the tested DraftStore source in E1. Accepted #306 changes admission on the documentation base; this record does not reassign E1 to that newer store or claim native UI termination/provider behavior.
